provenance.title: Memoizing cache collections (FIFO/LRU/LFU/TTL)
provenance.upstream_tests: not shipped in the sdist (tests/ only has __init__.py)
provenance.hidden_tests: written against upstream semantics (mapping protocol, getsizeof, eviction order per policy, TTL expiry with injected timer, key functions); every expected value cross-checked by running upstream cachetools 7.2.1
provenance.trimmed_detail: removed RRCache, TLRUCache, cached/cachedmethod decorators (_cached.py, _cachedmethod.py, func.py); kept Cache, FIFOCache, LFUCache, LRUCache, TTLCache and keys.py. LFU tie-breaking (arbitrary upstream) is not tested.
provenance.reference: hand-written idiomatic Jac port (claude): Cache as obj(MutableMapping), policies as obj subclasses with super calls, read-only currsize property
